ci_mode.description: Environment target. 'local' for development, 'github' for automated CI runs.

loop_mode.description: If true, orchestrator automatically pulls the next GOAL from USER_QUEUE after completion.

loop_delay_seconds.description: Cooldown period between tasks to prevent LLM API rate-limiting (HTTP 429).

max_task_attempts.description: Master circuit breaker: Maximum allowed failures for a single task before HALT.

max_continuous_tasks.description: Safety cap: Total number of sub-tasks the engine can process in one session.

active.description: Diagnostic phase: Agent assesses the codebase and requirements.
Architectural phase: Goal is decomposed into atomic tasks in TASKS.md.
Implementation phase: Coding and initial unit test generation.
Static analysis: Enforcing PEP8, type hints, and code cleanliness.
Logic verification: Running the pytest suite against the implementation.
Security & QA audit: Final check for secrets and quality patterns.
Final stage: Executes git operations and cloud integration based on vcs_control.

mode.description: Delivery strategy: 'local_git' (commits only), 'local_act' (local GHA simulation), 'github' (full cloud flow).

auto_push.description: Push the feature branch to remote origin after verification.

auto_pr.description: Create a Pull Request automatically using the GitHub REST API.

watch_gha.description: Wait for cloud tests to pass before marking the GOAL as completed. Ensures code works in production env. GitHub Actions

gha_timeout_minutes.description: Safety limit: If cloud tests run longer than this (in minutes), the task is marked as failed to prevent infinite waiting.

auto_commit.description: Automatically perform a git commit after each successful TASK.

branch_per_goal.description: Create a dedicated feature branch for every high-level GOAL.

workflow_file.description: The YAML file name in .github/workflows/ to be simulated by 'act'.

platform.description: Docker image mapping for local GHA simulation.

smart_fallback.description: Automatically switch to a backup LLM provider if the primary one fails.

http_connect_timeout.description: Maximum time to establish a network connection (Fast-Fail).

http_read_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a full LLM response (supports slow reasoning models).

retry_attempts.description: Number of automatic retries using stamina for 429/5xx errors.

retry_backoff_factor.description: Exponential multiplier for wait times between retries.

yellow_zone_threshold.description: Triggers ACTION_LOG compression at this context window percentage.

red_zone_threshold.description: Emergency threshold: Activates HALT to prevent context overflow.

show_task_id.description: Prefix every log line with [TASK-XXX] for traceability.

verbosity.description: Log level filtering (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR).
